govWatch.line: Something moves out there — Night Court.
🌾 Emberhold's tribute comes up thin — 3,612 of 4,000 kcal. They sent everything the wagons could carry, and it wasn't enough. The shortfall rides as arrears (+388 kcal). (Trust -1.)
🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (The Heckler, Murkcap, Night Court) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.
🚨 The Heckler, Murkcap, Night Court is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Night Court is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

⚔️ Yakym killed the Night Court with their party — 4 rounds, 34 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
Benoit leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Night Court. Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge
💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky i
Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.
◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. One head. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — polity tribute routing, the court calendar, famine reserves. You built a realm. Try not to lose it the way you found it."
